Leo · Listen & Shadow 20

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
SCENE 1 · HOW THE WEEK WENT
👤 Friend
So how's the week been treating you?
이번 주는 좀 어땠어?
treat — 대하다, 대접하다 · week — 한 주
같은 패턴으로 — How's the new job treating you? · How's the weather treating you up there? · How's the new place treating you?
💬 Leo
Honestly, it's been all over the place.
솔직히 좀 정신없었어.
honestly — 솔직히 · all over the place — 정신없는, 뒤죽박죽인
같은 패턴으로 — My schedule has been all over the place. · His desk is all over the place. · The traffic was all over the place this morning.
👤 Friend
What took up most of your time?
시간은 주로 어디에 들어갔어?
take up — (시간·자리를) 차지하다 · most of ~ — ~의 대부분
같은 패턴으로 — What took up most of your weekend? · The meeting took up most of the afternoon. · Moving took up most of my energy.
💬 Leo
Budget allocation. I've been doing the budget scheduling for next quarter.
예산 배분. 다음 분기 예산 일정을 짜고 있었거든.
budget allocation — 예산 배분 · scheduling — 일정 짜기 · quarter — 분기
같은 패턴으로 — I've been doing the planning for next month. · She's been doing the hiring for the new team.
💬 Leo
I haven't done it before, so it took longer than expected.
전에 해본 적이 없어서, 생각보다 오래 걸렸어.
expected — 예상된 · take long — 오래 걸리다
같은 패턴으로 — The repair took longer than expected. · Getting there took longer than expected. · The call took longer than expected.
👤 Friend
Anything still on your mind?
아직 걸리는 거 있어?
on one's mind — 마음에 걸리는, 신경 쓰이는
같은 패턴으로 — Is something on your mind? · That's been on my mind all week.
💬 Leo
One thing. I try not to push the team too hard when the numbers are tight.
하나 있어. 숫자가 빡빡할 때 팀을 너무 밀어붙이지 않으려고 해.
push — 밀어붙이다 · tight — 빠듯한, 빡빡한
같은 패턴으로 — I try not to check my phone at dinner. · I try not to eat too late. · He tries not to book meetings on Fridays.
SCENE 2 · THE NEW KEYBOARD
👤 Friend
Didn't you buy something recently?
너 요즘 뭐 하나 사지 않았어?
recently — 최근에
같은 패턴으로 — Didn't you move recently? · Didn't you meet him recently?
💬 Leo
I did. I've been thinking a lot about a new keyboard, and I finally got one.
맞아. 새 키보드를 계속 생각하다가, 드디어 하나 샀어.
finally — 드디어, 마침내
같은 패턴으로 — I've been thinking a lot about moving. · I've been thinking a lot about that trip. · She's been thinking a lot about changing jobs.
👤 Friend
What kind?
어떤 건데?
kind — 종류
💬 Leo
An aluminum one. It was around 200,000 won.
알루미늄 판으로 된 거. 20만 원 정도 했어.
aluminum — 알루미늄 · around — 대략, ~쯤
같은 패턴으로 — It was around 50,000 won. · The flight was around 900 dollars. · Dinner was around 30,000 won a person.
👤 Friend
That's not cheap.
싸진 않네.
cheap — 싼
같은 패턴으로 — That's not bad. · That's not far. · That's not easy.
💬 Leo
Most good ones are in the 100,000-won range, so I went a bit over.
괜찮은 건 대부분 십만 원대라서, 좀 넘게 쓴 거지.
in the ~ range — ~대(가격대) · go over — (예산을) 넘기다
같은 패턴으로 — Most of them are in the 50,000-won range. · Hotels there are in the 200-dollar range. · Their laptops are in the two-million-won range.
💬 Leo
I got overly excited and paid the deposit the same day.
너무 신나서 그날 바로 예약금을 넣어버렸어.
overly — 지나치게 · deposit — 예약금, 보증금 · the same day — 그날 바로
같은 패턴으로 — I got overly excited and bought two. · She got overly excited and told everyone. · He paid the deposit last week.
👤 Friend
Was it worth it?
그만한 값어치는 해?
worth — ~할 가치가 있는
같은 패턴으로 — Was the trip worth it? · Is the upgrade worth it? · It was worth every won.
💬 Leo
Every key feels solid. No regrets.
키 하나하나가 단단해. 후회 없어.
solid — 단단한 · regret — 후회
같은 패턴으로 — The table feels solid. · The plan feels solid. · No regrets about quitting.
SCENE 3 · WHERE TO NEXT
👤 Friend
If you could take off tomorrow, where would you go?
내일 당장 떠날 수 있다면 어디 갈래?
take off — 떠나다, 출발하다
같은 패턴으로 — If you could take off tomorrow, what would you pack? · If I could take off next week, I'd go home.
💬 Leo
Iceland. I really want to see the northern lights.
아이슬란드. 오로라를 꼭 한번 보고 싶어.
northern lights — 오로라, 북극광
같은 패턴으로 — I really want to see that show. · I really want to try that place.
👤 Friend
That's a long flight.
비행이 길겠는데.
flight — 비행, 항공편
같은 패턴으로 — That's a long drive. · That's a long walk.
💬 Leo
I know. Palau is on the list too, for the diving.
알아. 팔라우도 목록에 있어, 다이빙 때문에.
on the list — 목록에 있는 · diving — 다이빙
같은 패턴으로 — Jeju is on the list too. · That restaurant is on the list too.
👤 Friend
So you like both — cold and tropical?
추운 데랑 열대, 둘 다 좋아하는 거야?
tropical — 열대의
같은 패턴으로 — You like both — coffee and tea? · He likes both — running and swimming.
💬 Leo
What I really look for is the balance between city and nature.
내가 진짜 찾는 건 도시랑 자연 사이의 균형이야.
look for — 찾다, 원하다 · balance — 균형
같은 패턴으로 — What I really look for is a quiet room. · What I really look for is good coffee nearby.
💬 Leo
Too strict a schedule ruins a trip for me.
일정이 너무 빡빡하면 여행이 망가져, 나한텐.
strict — 엄격한, 빡빡한 · ruin — 망치다
같은 패턴으로 — Too much coffee ruins my sleep. · A strict rule like that ruins the fun.
💬 Leo
I'd rather dive into the place than watch it from a bus window.
버스 창밖으로 보기보다, 그 안으로 들어가고 싶어.
dive into ~ — ~에 뛰어들다, 깊이 들어가다 · rather A than B — B보다 A하고 싶다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd rather cook than order in. · I'd rather walk than take a taxi. · She'd rather dive into the work than plan it forever.
